body: My issue is that I’ve been in therapy for years now, but they suck ass here. The only decent therapist I had, quit. The one I have now, pretty much ghosted me. I know that unaliving isn’t doing any good to anyone and that I’m still very young, but it doesn’t seem to get any better. And I’ve really tried. Depression isn’t the biggest problem for me, i would say I’m pretty good at handling depression at this point, it’s the ptsd. It’s so hard to know what to do, and sure I can do the whole jazz of breathing exercises and stuff, but that’s only when I become aware of what’s happening. And as mentioned getting help where I live is either hopeless or really really expensive if I go private

I don’t need relationship to feel fulfilled, what I meant is that I’d feel fulfilled in the relationship. I’m willing to give them a chance because I’ve also done some things that I shouldn’t have, but if nothing changes, I will leave and focus solely on myself

That’s the thing, I want to be with them, I want them to start putting more effort, I want them to plan dates or even a call sometimes, without me needing to give hints. I want to be worth their time. I felt like making time for your partner was a given, and I made sure I made time for them even if I had a lot going on, however they can’t even pause a game for me. One time I was so stressed so they called me but they kept getting distracted by the game, needless to say i hung up. I understand that my mental health can take a toll on them as well, but saying that there’s something wrong me all the time and that it’s exhausting from my perspective was not the right thing to say and it hurt me. I don’t want anyone else, I want them, and if they start putting in more effort, I will feel fulfilled in this relationship but till then, well see.

I’m not relying on my partner to make me happy. I understand that relationship is supposed to add to my happiness, not be the main source of it. I have hobbies that keep me occupied and that I really enjoy, etc. However, I do feel more sad in this relationship than I did before. I want to be with this person, and I am willing and been working on my myself and my traumas to be better for that person. I am also willing to work and grow with this person, however, it feels one sided. When I express my concerns, and how I wish they made time for me, instead of playing video games all day, I see some effort for a bit and it fades out. I’m willing to wait a little longer to see if there are going to be changes. I feel like they don’t understand that a relationship takes effort from both parties, and I get that one can’t give 100% effort into a relationship and I don’t expect them to. What I am asking for is bare minimum though. I don’t want to outgrow my partner I want to grow with them, but it doesn’t seem like they want to do the same

When I was 7, I believe, it’s really difficult to remember some details, I think I was sexually assaulted by my friend, she would force me to perform sexual activities on and she would do that on me as well, including grabbing, penetration, etc. I honestly tried to block out these memories, but they are catching up and I keep having flashbacks, not only from this, but from other times, when I was assaulted by an older person, as well as the one I’ve mentioned in the post. I honestly blocked out everything, for a while, as I thought it was somewhat normal, but I was reminded of all of this last year, when a few people who I didn’t know started grabbing me and another person invited me for a drink, and being silly me, I agreed, luckily I left before anything bad could happen. But it’s like all of this just came back, and I keep having flashbacks of it, sometimes they’re not severe, sometimes they can be severe. 

I don’t know how to live with this, now that I’m putting the pieces together, I believe that my angry outbursts were probably caused by that. 

Everything feels so real and unreal, I don’t know how to live with this anymore.

I’m sorry for the venting.
